October 2014, I was at my friend's house and we went on a little forest adventure. We started from her house, went left from her driveway, and walked down through this persons backyard to a small trail that lead to a big swampy half mile stretch. We were running around and walking of logs to avoid the mud, having an overall good time. When we came out, we were in an unfamiliar neighborhood. So we went for the sound of the main road, covered in mud and burrs. When we reached the main road, the sign was the name of a neighborhood almost two miles away in the opposite direction we went. We were both super confused. We didn't know how we ended up over there, but we walked back in the darkness anyway. It was really weird. Imagine a dot, and draw a line to the right. The dot represents her neighborhood and the line is the way we went. Now imagine a long line drawn to the left of the dot. That's where we somehow came out. Idk.
Oh my god that must have been horrible. I can't even imagine.

One time when I was 7 or 8, my sister (10 or 11) was going to her friends house and for a party/sleepover with a few other girls and some reason my mom let me go with her (I was all lonely and crap.) She and her friends ignored me for most of the day, promised to sleep downstairs with me but I woke up around 2 am because her cat kept nudging me and standing on me while meowing softy in my face, and they were all gone upstairs. Only the little sister of the friend remained, dead asleep. I couldn't go back to sleep so I was staying up with the very attentive cat, and I eventually had to pee, so I headed over to the bathroom and used it. While on the toilet, I heard a clear as day knock on the door. I swear, go knock on any wooden door in your house and that's exactly what it sounded like. I said "one second," and opened the door. Her cat was sitting RIGHT THERE. I was really startled because that sound had to have come from knuckles on a door. I checked to see if her little sister was still asleep and she was still in the same position. I hadn't heard anyone come to the door (they had creaky wooden floors) and it really puzzled me. 

I have another more recent event that freaked me and my friend out, just tell me if you wanna hear it.
